paragraphs.text: Cromat is a legendary illusion from Dominaria .

Cromat is a legendary illusion on Dominaria from the Pre- Mending Era that is composed of all five colors of mana . It can gain various abilities of each color including destroy , flying , regenerate , counters , and bounce . In one form it looks like a large caterpillar-like insect with large wings. Nothing else is known about the creature besides its appearance and abilities.
